Market status from population.py: Roster-ready / Registered · not calibrated / Not available (filled north star / hollow ring / no mark). Agent-stars show the shape of the place, not where people live or the panel size. Illustrative. Land-only agent-stars on an orthographic globe, one turn per loop; depth by size and opacity. No coastlines or borders are drawn on the globe, and no market status.
